subject: Nonlinear upgrade/downgrade scenarios and rollback clarity
messages:
From: Ellie Roberts <ellie@healwell.io>
To: chloe_martin@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@healwell.io
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Packaging question: can we swap features mid-term?

Hi Chloe,

Quick one — the execs are asking whether the package we pilot with (Compact-Plus) can be rebalanced mid-contract if usage spikes. Specifically: if we upgrade to an elastic seat pool for Q4 but then need to step down in Q1 next year, how does proration/credits work? Also want to understand if certain premium features (private VPC + audit retention) can be toggled on/off without a full amendment.

We have a procurement window next week so a short summary would be great.

Thanks,
Ellie Roberts
Head of Platform, HealWell
---
HealWell | procurement@healwell.io
From: chloe_martin@redwood.ai
To: Ellie Roberts <ellie@healwell.io>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Packaging question: can we swap features mid-term?

Ellie — thanks for the clear ask. Short answer: yes, with caveats. Longer answer below and I attached a one-page pricing summary that maps common upgrade/downgrade flows.

Key points:
- Seat/throughput tier changes: we support step-up and step-down moves. Step-ups (upgrade) are immediate and billed pro rata from the change date. Step-downs are also pro rata but subject to the minimum commitment period in the contract (typically 30 days of equivalent usage) unless we agree a one-time exception.
- Add-ons (VPC, audit retention, dedicated logs): these can be toggled on short notice, but VPC provisioning has a ~5 business day lead time and audit retention changes may require a contract amendment for the retention SLA.
- Credits: unused committed capacity converts to account credits at the committed rate; we do not issue cash refunds.

I'll loop Ben on details for MA plan and an optional rollback play we can include in the SOW. If you want, we can propose two explicit scenarios in writing: (A) elastic upgrade for Q4 with automatic step-down to baseline in March; (B) continuous Elastic but capped spend with hard stop. Which would you prefer?

Attachments: HealWell_pricing_summary_v2.xlsx (pricing scenarios + proration examples).

Cheers,
Chloe Martin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
chloe@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0187
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Ellie Roberts <ellie@healwell.io>, chloe_martin@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Packaging question: can we swap features mid-term?

Ellie — adding the MA plan view and a recommended rollback clause in the attached PDF. Practical notes we include in these clauses:
- Proration math example: if the upgrade happens on 10/15 and the month is billed monthly, you pay pro rata for the remainder of October at the upgraded rate; step-down credits apply to future invoices.
- One-time goodwill flexibility: for customers with >$100k ARR we sometimes offer a one-time carve-out to waive the 30-day minimum for a downgrade; this is subject to approvals and trade-offs on discounts.
- Quantization/instance-level changes (e.g., moving to lower-precision quantized serving): these require a 2-4 week validation window; we can sandbox during pilot.

If HealWell can commit to a 9-month pilot with a clear rollback trigger, I can propose a 10% pilot discount and a single-use downgrade grace in the amendment. Chloe, can you confirm if that discount is within the range you can approve or if we should escalate to Marissa?

—Ben
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Ellie Roberts <ellie@healwell.io>
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, chloe_martin@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Packaging question: can we swap features mid-term?

Thanks Ben / Chloe — that helps. A couple clarifications:
1) The pilot term would be 9 months starting 2027-09-01, with the possible elastic bump Oct–Dec for holiday volume. We want a clear, automatic step-down back to baseline in March unless we provide 30 days notice to retain the higher tier.
2) The single-use downgrade grace sounds useful — would that still count against any early termination obligations?
3) We also need confirmation that toggling audit retention from 1 year to 90 days will not delete existing logs immediately — we want to ensure retention changes are non-destructive and reversible for the term.

If you can confirm those three points, procurement can start the SOW review on Friday.

Ellie
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Ellie Roberts <ellie@healwell.io>, chloe_martin@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 6 Aug 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Packaging question: can we swap features mid-term?

Ellie — happy to confirm and provide the formal language we'll insert into the SOW/SLA. Answers inline: 
1) Pilot + automatic rollback: we can include an automatic step-down clause that executes on 2028-03-01 unless HealWell notifies us 30 days prior to retain the elevated tier. Execution will convert any over-allocated committed units into account credit at the committed rate for future invoices. 
2) Single-use downgrade grace: yes, we can offer a single-use waiver of the 30-day minimum as a one-time commercial concession tied to the pilot. It is not a termination waiver; early termination obligations (if invoked outside the pilot) are unaffected. We'll call this the "Pilot Downgrade Grace" in the SOW.
3) Audit retention toggles: changing retention window will not automatically purge existing logs; we will maintain data until the new retention window lapses, and we can provide an export snapshot on request before changes take effect.

Ben — Chloe — please attach the finalized MA plan and I'll sign off on the commercial concession to support the 10% pilot discount and the single-use downgrade grace. Ellie — I'll also attach redlined SOW language in DocuSign for your procurement team.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
